project_type: Modern Educational Platform - Vanilla JS + Supabase Backend
build_system: Static HTML/CSS/JS site - no build step required. Files loaded directly via ES modules from CDN (Supabase client)
test_framework: Manual testing via browser. No automated test framework currently in place.
build_command: None - direct file serving. Open HTML files in browser.
test_command: Manual browser testing at http://localhost or file:// protocol
verification_instructions:
1. Open teacher-classes.html in browser
2. Login as teacher (role='teacher' in profiles table)
3. Verify all CRUD operations work
4. Test RLS policies via Supabase Studio
5. Verify responsive design on mobile/desktop
6. Test light/dark theme toggle
7. Verify Arabic RTL layout
8. Test student profile associations
environment_constraints: Supabase connection required. Must test with valid teacher account (profiles.role='teacher'). RLS policies enforce strict access control - students cannot access teacher pages.
contribution_requirements:
- All text must be in Arabic
- RTL layout mandatory
- Support both light/dark themes (data-theme attribute)
- Follow existing CSS variable system in variables.css
- Match teacher-dashboard.css patterns for consistency
- Use Supabase RLS for security
- Follow existing auth patterns in teacher-nav.js
- Maintain responsive design (mobile-first approach)
- Use existing Toast notification system
- Follow showConfirmModal pattern for delete confirmations
key_patterns:
- Teacher pages use teacher-nav.js for auth, sidebar, theme
- CRUD pages follow teacher-users.js pattern: loadData -> renderTable -> openModal -> saveData
- Use supabase client from src/services/supabase.js
- Modal system: .modal class with .active state
- Table pattern: .td-table-wrapper > .td-table with hover states
- Pagination uses renderPagination() helper from teacher-nav.js
- Form validation shows Toast messages
- Delete operations require showConfirmModal confirmation
- All teacher pages call initTeacherAdmin(pageKey) on DOMContentLoaded
- Database performance: Migration 10 added indexes on profiles(grade, section, role) and school_sections(grade, is_active) for optimized queries
- RLS policies verified: students read active sections only, teachers manage all sections
directory_structure:
Root:
- *.html (teacher-*.html for admin pages, student pages at root)
- src/scripts/ (JS modules)
- src/styles/ (CSS files with CSS variables system)
- src/services/ (supabase.js, auth.js)
- src/utils/ (toast.js, student-identity.js)
- src/assets/images/ (logos, icons)
- supabase/migrations/ (SQL migration files)
- .agents/tasks/ (workflow artifacts)
